applications/standard/settings/BUILD.gn.content:

import("//build/ohos.gni")

# Compile the real Stage UI and extensions instead of the stale phone HAP.
ohos_app("settings_hap") {
  deps = []
  certificate_profile = "signature/settings.p7b"
  hap_name = "Settings"
  part_name = "settings"
  subsystem_name = "applications"
  module_install_dir = "app/com.ohos.settings"
  sdk_home = "//prebuilts/ohos-sdk/linux"
  sdk_type_name = [ "sdk.dir" ]
  assemble_type = "assembleHap"
  build_level = "module"
  build_modules = [ "phone" ]
  js_build_mode = "release"
}

import("//build/ohos.gni")

ohos_hap("adminprovisioning_hap") {
  hap_profile = "entry/src/main/module.json"
  deps = [
    ":adminprovisioning_js_assets",
    ":adminprovisioning_resources",
  ]
  certificate_profile = "signature/adminprovisioning.p7b"
  hap_name = "adminprovisioning"
  subsystem_name = "applications"
  part_name = "prebuilt_hap"
  module_install_dir = "app/com.ohos.adminprovisioning"
}

ohos_js_assets("adminprovisioning_js_assets") {
  ets2abc = true
  source_dir = "entry/src/main/ets"
}

ohos_app_scope("adminprovisioning_app_profile") {
  app_profile = "AppScope/app.json"
  sources = [ "AppScope/resources" ]
}

ohos_resources("adminprovisioning_resources") {
  sources = [ "entry/src/main/resources" ]
  deps = [ ":adminprovisioning_app_profile" ]
  hap_profile = "entry/src/main/module.json"
}
